items.text: Spearheaded Nike's first end-to-end sketch-to-3D generative pipeline, accelerating physical product design by allowing instant 2D-to-3D conceptual volume iteration.
Curated a proprietary dataset from physical footwear archives via 3D scanning to fine-tune state-of-the-art 3D models and automate CAD-to-3D pipelines.
Led the design and deployment of ML product ranking and matching algorithms across digital platforms (Nike App and Nike.com), driving a $300M increase in demand over two fiscal years.
Coordinated the architecture and launch of Nike's first conversational product finder, leveraging LLMs (PyTorch, LangChain, vector stores) and agentic multi-agent systems.

Orchestrated full-stack ML solutions from distributed ETL (PySpark, SQL) to deployment (Jenkins, Airflow, Kubernetes). Authored a core internal Python ML library for matching and ranking, standardizing feature extraction and inference across global engineering teams.

Led the research and fine-tuning of state-of-the-art diffusion models (SDXL, SD3, FLUX) for high-fidelity product imagery, optimizing parameters, LoRA/DreamBooth adapters, and text-to-image alignment.

Designed and automated a massive dataset generation and labeling pipeline (utilizing LLM/VLM annotation and image quality filtering) to train and fine-tune diffusion models, significantly reducing human annotation costs and accelerating iteration loops.
Conducted advanced research under Prof. Ping Li, publishing 8+ papers in elite conferences (ICLR, NeurIPS, KDD, UAI, ACML, ALT).

Solved communication bottlenecks in resource-constrained environments by developing FedSKETCH (communication-efficient federated learning via sketching) and Fed-LAMB (locally adaptive federated learning).
Researched and developed advanced gradient compression and adaptive optimization methods for training large-scale deep learning models, improving convergence speed and generalization.
Designed dual energy-flow enhanced Graph Neural Networks for multimodal VQA, integrating object and relation graphs.
Collaborated with Dr. Dmitry Vetrov on hyperparameter weight averaging (HWA) and stochastic optimization in high-dimensional Bayesian Neural Networks, resulting in publications at AABI.
Proved global convergence of incremental expectation maximization (EM) and developed stochastic approximation methods for large-scale datasets, publishing papers in COLT (2019) and NeurIPS (2019).
Main author and developer of Saemix, an open-source R package for parameter estimation in non-linear mixed-effects models, generating 18,000+ yearly downloads.
Conducted machine learning research under the supervision of Dr. Vikash Mansinghka (Brain and Cognitive Sciences department).

Applied Bayesian statistics and probabilistic programming to automate diagnostic tools and data sketches in collaboration with the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation, enabling domain experts to perform qualitative model checks.
